en.title: Checking Target Assignments
en.excerpt: How archers check assigned target numbers, shooting wave orders, and competition schedules on mobile devices.
en.content:
Viewing Target Assignments

When the tournament committee publishes the target layout, open your Archer Dashboard > select the tournament > tap My Target.

Understanding Your Letter Position

Your target card displays your exact lane assignment (e.g., Target 14B):

  • Target 14: The physical foam target butt on the field.
  • Position B: You shoot in Wave 1 on the right side of the target.

Reporting Times & Equipment Inspections

Check the scheduled start time for official practice ends to ensure you complete equipment inspection with line judges before scoring begins.
